historical_incidents.title: Checkout dropping connections
historical_incidents.description: At 08:42 UTC, checkout requests began returning HTTP 504. DB connections maxed out.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Traffic spike exhausted connection pool.

historical_incidents.title: OMS unable to reach database
historical_incidents.description: Complete checkout halt. DB rejecting incoming connections from app pods.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Network partition between app tier and DB tier.

historical_incidents.title: 500s on order submission
historical_incidents.description: Orders failing at 14:00. PostgreSQL logging 'sorry, too many clients already'.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Heavy ad-hoc report query locked table and consumed pool.

historical_incidents.title: DB pool maxed out alerts
historical_incidents.description: New Relic reported 100% connection usage on pg-oms. OMS latency increasing.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: PgBouncer misconfiguration after routine restart.

historical_incidents.title: OMS DB exhaustion right after Inventory deploy
historical_incidents.description: Inventory deployed 09:00. OMS DB crashed 09:15. Checkout halted.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: A cron job on the DB started at 09:15. Inventory deploy was coincidental.

historical_incidents.title: Order creation latency after deploy
historical_incidents.description: Following the 09:00 rollout, OMS response times increased by 4x.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Un-indexed query introduced in v3.9.0.

historical_incidents.title: High error rate post-release
historical_incidents.description: Checkout API returning 400s for valid payloads continuously.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Validation logic error in new release.

historical_incidents.title: Missing fields in order payload
historical_incidents.description: Downstream services failing to parse orders. Missing total_amount.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Schema change deployed without backward compatibility.

historical_incidents.title: Memory leak in OMS pods
historical_incidents.description: OMS pods OOMKilled every 2 hours causing rolling degradation.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Caching bug in new library version.

historical_incidents.title: OMS crash on startup
historical_incidents.description: New pods failing readiness probes immediately after startup.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Missing environment variable for feature flag.

historical_incidents.title: Orders not reaching warehouse
historical_incidents.description: Fulfillment center reports 0 new orders since 10 AM.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: WMS consumer paused due to unparseable JSON payload.

historical_incidents.title: Fulfillment delays and high CPU
historical_incidents.description: Warehouse SLAs breached. WMS DB CPU locked at 100%.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Autovacuum stuck in Postgres causing severe bloat.
historical_incidents.resolution: Manual vacuum run on affected tables.

historical_incidents.title: WMS worker crash after deploy
historical_incidents.description: Workers crashing at 11:15 after 11:00 deploy. No orders processing.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Bad memory limit in v2.2.0 helm chart.

historical_incidents.title: Missing packing slips
historical_incidents.description: Printers in warehouse stopped receiving data streams.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Internal WMS worker thread exhaustion due to slow API.
historical_incidents.resolution: Restarted WMS pods and increased thread pool.

historical_incidents.title: Inventory reservation failures
historical_incidents.description: WMS unable to reserve stock, leaving orders in pending state.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Inventory API aggressively rate limiting WMS calls.
historical_incidents.resolution: Increased rate limit tier for WMS.

historical_incidents.title: Adyen timeouts
historical_incidents.description: Payments failing with gateway timeout. Latency > 10s.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Adyen API degraded globally.

historical_incidents.title: Stripe API 503s
historical_incidents.description: Checkout abandoning at payment step. Adapter logging network drops.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Network NAT gateway IP addresses exhausted.

historical_incidents.title: Payment gateway timeout immediately after config push
historical_incidents.description: At 14:05, payments started timing out. An OMS config deploy happened at 14:00.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Upstream Stripe was down. The OMS deploy was coincidental.

historical_incidents.title: Payment circuit breaker open
historical_incidents.description: All payments routed to fallback processor erroneously.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Temporary internal network blip triggered aggressive breaker.

historical_incidents.title: Payment API crash after deploy
historical_incidents.description: Payment gateway completely unresponsive after 10:00 update.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Missing dependency in v1.5.0 container image.

historical_incidents.title: Cart state lost globally
historical_incidents.description: Users logged out, carts emptying randomly.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Redis OOM eviction policy aggressively deleted active sessions.

historical_incidents.title: Redis connection reset
historical_incidents.description: OMS logging 'connection reset by peer' when talking to cache.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Redis node underlying hardware failure.

historical_incidents.title: High Redis CPU
historical_incidents.description: Redis CPU locked at 99%. OMS latency climbing.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Expensive KEYS * query run accidentally by developer in production.

historical_incidents.title: Redis OOM right after WMS deploy
historical_incidents.description: WMS deployed at 11:00. At 11:10 Redis OOMed.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Marketing email blast caused traffic spike. WMS deploy unrelated.

historical_incidents.title: Cart button missing
historical_incidents.description: After the 14:00 deploy, add to cart button vanished.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: CSS class renamed incorrectly in v2.10.1.

historical_incidents.title: Frontend 502 Bad Gateway right after config change
historical_incidents.description: At 10:15, ingress returned 502s. Frontend deploy happened at 10:00.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: AWS Load Balancer routing failure. Frontend deploy was coincidental.

historical_incidents.title: Blank white screen on product page
historical_incidents.description: React application crashing on render.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Null pointer in product gallery component.
historical_incidents.resolution: Hotfix deployed to bypass broken component.

historical_incidents.title: CORS errors on checkout
historical_incidents.description: API requests blocked by browser pre-flight checks.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Bad origin configuration in API gateway.

historical_incidents.title: Consumer lag spiking across all topics
historical_incidents.description: WMS and Inventory lag > 100k messages.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Kafka broker memory limits hit causing JVM GC pauses.

historical_incidents.title: Kafka partition offline
historical_incidents.description: One broker down, causing under-replicated partitions.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Disk full on broker 2 due to retention policy bug.
historical_incidents.resolution: Expanded EBS volume and restarted broker.

historical_incidents.title: WMS consumer dropping messages
historical_incidents.description: Kafka consumer group continuously rebalancing.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Network instability causing heartbeat timeouts.

historical_incidents.title: High publish latency
historical_incidents.description: OMS taking > 500ms to publish to Kafka.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: No leader available for partition 3.

historical_incidents.title: Warehouse DB replication lag
historical_incidents.description: Read replicas 15 mins behind primary.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Heavy batch insert locked WAL stream.

historical_incidents.title: WMS DB disk full
historical_incidents.description: Postgres stopped accepting writes.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Archived logs filled secondary disk.

historical_incidents.title: High IOPS on warehouse DB
historical_incidents.description: Query latency high impacting WMS operations.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Missing index on fulfillment table.

historical_incidents.title: Database connection reset
historical_incidents.description: WMS disconnected from pg-wms unexpectedly.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: OOM killer terminated Postgres process.

historical_incidents.title: Inventory counts stale
historical_incidents.description: Stock not updating on storefront.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Third-party supplier API outage.

historical_incidents.title: Internal DNS resolution failure
historical_incidents.description: Services unable to find each other via service mesh.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: CoreDNS pod crashlooping in cluster.

historical_incidents.title: Expired TLS certificate
historical_incidents.description: API gateway rejecting all external traffic.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: Automated cert renewal script failed.

historical_incidents.title: Missing metrics in New Relic
historical_incidents.description: Telemetry suddenly stopped arriving for OMS.
symptoms: System degradation reported via telemetry alerts
historical_incidents.root_cause: New Relic agent memory limit hit.
